# 00000005471

**English.** Definition: Factorized scattering is the multiplicative scattering of two-dimensional integrable systems. Conjecture: The Yangian symmetry of type A_3 is generated by explicit nonlocal charges, the conversion of generators with the scattering closes through the structure relations, and the minimal number of generators is three. (nonlocal charge generation of A_3 Yangian symmetry)

**中文。** 定义：因子化散射指二维可积的乘法型散射。猜想：A₃ 型的杨对称由显式非局域荷生成,生成元与散射的换算经结构关系闭合且最小生成数为三。（A3 杨对称非局域荷生成）
